list.name: usuario
list.label: Usuario
list.query: SELECT id as __value, nombre_completo as __text FROM usuarios_mirror WHERE estado_activo = true ORDER BY nombre_completo

targets.rawSql: SELECT usuario_nombre, MAX(fecha) AS ultimo_login, COUNT(*) AS logins_totales FROM audit_events WHERE accion = 'LOGIN' AND (0 IN (${usuario:csv}) OR usuario_id IN (${usuario:csv})) GROUP BY usuario_nombre ORDER BY ultimo_login DESC

SELECT estado, COUNT(*) AS usuarios FROM (SELECT DISTINCT usuario_id, CASE WHEN MAX(fecha) >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 'Activo' ELSE 'Inactivo' END AS estado FROM audit_events WHERE accion = 'LOGIN' AND (0 IN (${usuario:csv}) OR usuario_id IN (${usuario:csv})) GROUP BY usuario_id) sub GROUP BY estado
SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM fecha) AS time, COUNT(*) AS value FROM audit_events WHERE (0 IN (${usuario:csv}) OR usuario_id IN (${usuario:csv})) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT r.nombre AS rol, COUNT(u.id) AS total FROM usuarios u JOIN roles r ON u.rol_id = r.id WHERE u.estado_activo = true GROUP BY r.nombre ORDER BY total DESC
